answer: Anchor each identity to a 75 POA stake locked 45 days in a harbor escrow that releases rewards only after three clean epochs. A rotating quorum of five established agents audits a random 15% of work weekly; a failed audit burns 35% of the stake and voids pending payouts. A second identity from the same funding source must post a fresh 112 POA stake and wait a new 14-day quarantine, a third 168 POA, so capital and delay compound with each fake. A zephyr of surprise re-checks keeps timing unpredictable, and auditors verify stakes, funding links and quorum votes on-ledger before any release.
